title: Hierarchical System Design Document Schema
description: JSON schema for hierarchical system design documents with responsibilities, services, and transactions

root.description: Root container for the system design document

purpose.description: A comprehensive description of the system's purpose, goals, and intended outcomes
purpose.pattern: ^The purpose of the product is to .+$

responsibilities.description: List of system responsibilities with their associated services and transactions

responsibility.description: A system responsibility with its associated services and transactions

description.description: Detailed description of what this responsibility entails

services.description: List of services that implement this responsibility

service.description: A service that implements part of a responsibility

description.description: Detailed description of what this service does

transactions.description: List of specific transactions or operations this service performs

items.description: A specific transaction or operation description
